q1_issues.issue: The consequent is never tied to its trigger: the whenever machinery specifies the response Skolem event be linked to the trigger occurrence with During, and no During (or any other) link between (sk_accumulate $x) and the hunt event $e is emitted.

(sk_accumulate $x) and (sk_feathers $x) are Skolem functions of the sky-cat alone although the rule also quantifies the hunt event $e, so a sky-cat that hunts across several summers yields one single accumulation event and one single feather group rather than one per occurrence.

q2_gaps: A temporal-extent preposition over a named period ('hunts through summer'). During is restricted to during/while/throughout and requires both eventualities reified, and a season has no reified or structured-term form; a bare (Time $e summer) records the slot but drops the 'through' extent, and no other Time head (Start/End, Measure duration, WithinLast) fits an uncounted extent over a named season.
notes: (PartOf sk_base_1 sk_cliff_1) for the part-relational of-phrase 'the base of the cliff', Location on the event rather than LocatedIn, the sky_cat genus with the noun modifier correctly unexposed, CardinalityPhrase 'many' as a count of things rather than a proportion strength, and (TimeAtMost ... autumn) for the 'by autumn' deadline all follow the instruction set.
